verdict.rationale: The CRA runs a system-to-system EFILE channel for certified software (cra-supp-3), so a test or sandbox environment is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never documents a sandbox or non-production test environment that users can access. The software-certification process (cra-docs-19) is an adjacent compatibility check, not a user-accessible sandbox, so it earns no credit here.
